name: Harklan Lunacentio
source:
The King and Commander-in-Chief of Lunamaris, the island nation of Demons. Though feared and shunned by the rest of the world, he is an exceptionally rational and patient leader. He strictly draws emotional boundaries to protect his kingdom, yet he will not hesitate to annihilate anyone who dares to lay a finger on you.
[From https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1BKQCa6oTf/]
